history.summary: Brand-new Clementi GLS launch (CSC Land/MCL, ~501 units) whose 4BR at $2,345 PSF is priced at/below the development's own $2,363+ PSF launch range and beneath the $2,576 district new-launch median. Top-tier school belt and a CRL interchange at Clementi by ~2032 give a clear catalyst, but $3.08M for a 4BR sits in the thinner high-price band.
history.rating_rationale: This 4BR at $2,345 PSF is keenly priced — web-verified ELTA 4BR launch starts ~$2,363 PSF and resale Clavon (5yr) already trades ~$2,393 PSF, so you buy a 0-year-old unit at parity-or-below. CRL Clementi interchange (~2032), Nan Hua/NUS High school belt and 404-txn district liquidity support it. New-launch bias means no reliable resale CAGR yet, and $3.08M narrows the buyer pool.
red_flags: New launch — no resale-to-resale appreciation track; entry pricing already full
Clementi MRT ~1km, not walk-up; CRL benefit is 2032
catalysts: Cross Island Line — Clementi becomes interchange ~2032
Prime school belt (Nan Hua, NUS High, Pei Tong)
Priced at/below own launch range and district new-launch median

history.summary: New-launch 4BR at parity to resale comps — no value edge — and a $3.12M quantum that materially thins the resale pool; CRL Clementi (~2032) is real but distant.
history.rating_rationale: Bought at launch parity to 5yr-old Clavon (~$2,393psf), so no cheap-for-age margin. 4BR $3.12M is a thin-liquidity ticket. D05 RCR region neutral. The school belt + CRL support hold value but don't make it a forward outperformer at this entry.
red_flags: new-launch parity pricing, no value margin
catalysts: Nan Hua / NUS High school belt
history.as_of: 2026-06 re-judgment under v3.10b priors (de-biased value+region lead, trailing CAGR≈0, deep-discount/yield trust rules)
